title: 记录页子表页签恢复读者调整：每个子表页签的菜单可左移、右移、隐藏，「更多」里可恢复默认（承 #35595）
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbSphdunq2aJq7ktuY

Ruling-ref: priority:p1 · the maintainer, 2026-11-20 (seat 5 decision card on the #35763 removal): 「先合并，另开卡恢复」

Split from #35595 by seat 5, area ux-1. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens today (after PR #35763)

- Reader arrangement used to live on the record page's related cards: the ⠿ handle, ⌥↑ / ⌥↓ and 「隐藏」 (#27055). PR #35763 replaced those cards with one tab per related list and a read-only Overview rail, so a reader can no longer reorder or hide a related list.
- An order or hides already stored still apply. 「恢复默认顺序」 / 「显示」 still undo them, but only from the rail's foot. A drawer or an embedded pane has no rail, so there is no way to reset there.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/relatedArrangement.ts` still holds the arrangement reducer, and the i18n keys for move, hide and reset still exist. `RelatedCardStack.tsx`, `RelatedCardMenu.tsx` and `useRelatedArrangement.ts` are no longer drawn by any page.

## What to do

1. Give each related-list tab a menu with 「左移」, 「右移」 and 「隐藏」. They write the same stored arrangement through `relatedArrangement.ts`'s reducer, so a stored order and stored hides keep working.
2. Put a reset entry in the tab row's 「更多」 menu: 「恢复默认顺序」 and show the hidden lists again. This also covers the drawer and the embedded pane, which have no rail foot.
3. Reuse the existing i18n keys. Add a key only where none fits.
4. Delete `RelatedCardStack`, `RelatedCardMenu` and `useRelatedArrangement` if nothing else imports them, along with their tests. Move the reducer's tests over if they live with the deleted files.
5. Overview, Attachments, Approvals and Activity cannot be moved or hidden.

## Done when

- On a record page, a reader moves a related tab left and right, hides it, and gets everything back with the reset in 「更多」. The change persists the way #27055's arrangement did.
- The same works in a drawer.
- Tests pin move, hide, reset and the fixed tabs. One e2e covers move, hide and reset. A `docs/qa/platform-checklist` item is added or edited.
- Estimate: about 400–600 lines.

Reader: `domain:ui` lane, `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/{RecordTabRow.tsx,synth/recordTabRow.ts,synth/relatedArrangement.ts}`.
